Subject: Welcome + logistics for your final interview on May 11

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for taking the time to loop with us. We’re excited to host your final round on Tuesday, May 11. Below is the hybrid logistics summary; please let me know if anything needs adjusting.

Schedule (PDT):
- 9:30 AM — Quick check-in with Recruiting (Zoom or in-person reception)
- 10:00 AM — Technical design + system architecture (Markus Klein) — 60 min
- 11:15 AM — Lunch break / campus tour (optional)
- 12:30 PM — Product + PM interview (Lauren Bishop) — 45 min
- 1:30 PM — Wrap / Q&A with hiring team (Mina Haddad) — 30 min

Location: Redwood HQ — Building B, Room 204 (hybrid room). We will run the loop via Zoom for remote fallback: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210 (Passcode: Redwood!2026).

Attachments included: candidate_welcome_kit.pdf (agenda + interviewer bios), campus_map.png. I’m also attaching a calendar invite (final_round_calendar.ics) — accept if that works.

Accessibility and travel: if you need live captions, ASL/interpretation, or assistance with campus arrival (ride voucher), we can arrange those. Please reply with any accessibility needs or dietary restrictions and whether you’d like us to book a ride to campus.

Next steps: please confirm the time slots, whether you’ll be in person or remote, and any accommodations by EOD Wednesday so we can lock rooms and vendors.

Best,

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the detailed note and the invite. I’ll plan to come onsite for the first two interviews and can join the later sessions via Zoom if that’s easier for the team. A few requests:

- Live captions please for the technical design session (I process spoken English faster with live captions).
- ASL interpreter for the morning segment (I’ll provide the name if needed; I’m coordinating with my provider).
- I’d appreciate a ride voucher from the nearest Caltrain station to the office — my mobility is limited after long travel.
- Vegetarian lunch (no dairy, please).

If it helps, I can meet at 9:15 AM in the lobby. Otherwise, 9:30 AM check-in works.

Best regards,
Asha Patel
